decision: t_e6e0645e Stop named-root writes slowing with each update
why: At c5921381cf, getChangeValue (packages/plitejs/src/core/public-state.ts:9285) caches values in CHANGE_VALUES under main's children array and appends one entry per update; a write to a named root leaves that array the same, so the list grows by one per update and every lookup (from dropOrphanedRootsOnce) scans it with an every() over all roots. With Indent, 200 main paragraphs and 50 content roots, a write to the last root's block 100 slows from about 2 ms to 22 ms per update over 1,000 updates, through a view or by key from the main editor, while main writes stay flat; an untimed main write between updates keeps note writes at 0.5 to 0.7 ms. Typing in a section or note is a named-root write per keystroke.
